_readme: PERMANENT test vectors. schema/trusty-identifiers.md: "Keep test vectors forever. Every supported profile needs fixed positive and negative vectors so future library upgrades cannot silently change IDs." If a dependency bump breaks these, the identifiers in the wild broke too — fix the code, never the vectors.

ga4gh_cross_check.note: Verbatim from the GA4GH VRS spec; proves our digest primitive is byte-compatible.

vectors.name: minimal-activity
vectors.note: Baseline. Locks canonicalization + sha512t24u against library upgrades.

vectors.name: activity-timestamp-changed
vectors.note: SAME expected_id as minimal-activity. generated_at_time is unhashable, so re-running a pipeline must not change what the activity IS.

vectors.name: activity-command-changed
vectors.note: DIFFERENT id. command is hashable: change the analysis, change the identity.

vectors.name: dataset-creators-ordered
vectors.note: Author order is citation-bearing (DataCite), so the list index is part of the digest.

vectors.name: dataset-creators-reversed
vectors.note: DIFFERENT id from dataset-creators-ordered. Proves order is preserved, not sorted.

vectors.name: nested-reference-substitution
vectors.note: A dapper: reference contributes only its BARE digest, as GA4GH VRS requires.

vectors.name: minimal-gene-program
vectors.note: Baseline for the 4.0 single-cell block. GeneProgram extends Set the same way GeneSet does. Renamed from CellProgram; the class name is part of the digest, so the id changed even though the content did not.

vectors.name: gene-program-gene-count-changed
vectors.note: DIFFERENT id from minimal-gene-program. n_genes is hashable: a different loading is a different program.

vectors.name: cell-state-references-program
vectors.note: A CellState digests the GeneProgram(s) active in it via their bare digest, same as nested-reference-substitution.
